description: Na₂S₂O₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent S and five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₂O₅ pentagonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.89 Å) and one longer (3.03 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent S and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.89 Å) and one longer (3.07 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.02 Å. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond length. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom.
